name: aMuTorrent
description: A unified download manager for aMule, rTorrent, qBittorrent, Deluge and Transmission: manage ED2K and BitTorrent downloads from a single modern web interface.

notes.text: Follow the setup wizard on first login, then add your download clients (aMule, rTorrent, qBittorrent, Deluge, Transmission).
aMule needs its EC interface reachable on port 4712 and rTorrent an XML-RPC endpoint before clients can connect.
